assumption: Teams will document rejected alternatives as well as selected ideas
Participants can distinguish evidence from preference during assumption mapping
Scenario review will change option rankings before implementation
Prototype results will be available quickly enough to influence strategy
Dashboard metrics will not create false precision or gaming behavior
Affected communities will have enough time and context to review proposals meaningfully
Implementation dependencies can be mapped before major resource commitment
Decision-makers will act on second-order risk findings
Decision memory will be reused in future reviews rather than archived and ignored
Classifying options by strategic role will change portfolio decisions
Leaders will accept explicit criteria even when they expose political disagreement
Learning loop reviews will revise strategy rather than become retrospective reporting
